title.narrative: Apoyo al Programa de Reformas del Sector de Transportes
Program Sector Reforms Transportation

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es contribuir a mejorar la calidad de los servicios de transporte y la integracin nacional e internacional del pas, permitiendo el traslado seguro y eficiente de personas y bienes, a travs del desarrollo e implementacin del marco reglamentario, regulatorio y tcnico de la nueva Ley General de Transporte, con el fin de contribuir con la reforma del sector transporte que est llevando a cabo el Gobierno de Bolivia

The objective of the program is to contribute with the improvement of the quality of the transport services, and the national and international integration of the country, allowing for a secure and efficient movement of persons and goods, through the development and implementation of a regulatory framework of the new transport law (Law 165), with the aim of contributing with the reform of the transport sector that is implementing the Govenrment of Bolivia.
